# Vendored from pstack

`create-verification-skill` and `maintain-verification-skill` in `.claude/skills/` are copied unchanged from
[backnotprop/pstack](https://github.com/backnotprop/pstack) at commit `0d2dc00df47d7686c94324cfe9c3444710d9f16d`
(a harness-neutral mirror of Poteto's pstack, cursor/plugins/pstack). MIT License, see `LICENSE`.

To update: re-download `skills/create-verification-skill/**` and `skills/maintain-verification-skill/SKILL.md`
from a newer commit and update the hash above.
